tagline: Sanctuary in the Ancient Cedars of the Pacific Northwest
primary_audience: Urban wellness travelers, couples seeking secluded retreats, and sustainable luxury vacationers

aesthetic_direction.typography: Lyrical display serif (e.g. Ogg or Cormorant) paired with light, balanced geometric sans (e.g. Tenor Sans or Inter)
aesthetic_direction.composition: Cinematic visual storytelling, full-height atmospheric vignettes, seamless date-picker reservation integration, and sensory detail cards

media_guidelines: Warm, mist-filled golden hour photography of forest foliage, cedar hot tubs, and artisan plated dishes. Natural lighting only.
anti_patterns: Stock photos of unrelated tropical beaches
